count_unit: Actual classifier/regressor fitting invocations, including attempts that fail after entry. Do not count tree iterations, predictions, constructors, calibration multiplier search, dispatch wrappers or preprocessing fit calls as additional learners.

matrix.formula: 2 * (2 views * (1 inner + at most1 calibration refit +1 outer) +1 linear head +1 RBF head) =16

source_evidence: automl_worker.py108-117 dispatches two fixed views via sequential ensemble components; no learner for the mixture.
automl_worker.py280-320: nested inner fit; selected iterations floored by min_iterations100; a second inner fit occurs only if calibrated predictions must match the floored iteration count.
automl_worker.py326-341 extra calibration-fold fits are unreachable for this exact recipe: validate_feature_view20-21 requires calibration_folds default/equal1. No specialists/pair_refinement.
automl_worker.py343-344 fits the final outer-fitting learner once per leaf; component job full_fitFalse, no full-dataset refit or wholeagent search.

automl_execution_model_adapters_kernel_tabular.py97-161/210-237 fits preprocessing/optional mapper then one LogisticRegression head per job. BoundedTabularModel.fit is a wrapper around that head, not a second learner.

separate_preprocessing_accounting.strong: Fitting-scope frame preparation/target encoding executes for each actual inner/outer fit. The encoded view uses cross-fitted target encoding of fixed categorical pairs, smoothing20. No new model learners are fitted by those statistics. Report actual preprocessing operations separately.
separate_preprocessing_accounting.linear: One ColumnTransformer.fit_transform per job; if numeric columns exist: SimpleImputer median keep_empty_featuresTrue then StandardScaler with_meanFalse; if categorical columns exist: OneHotEncoder min_frequency3/max_categories64/unknownignore. These are preprocessing, not learner fits.
separate_preprocessing_accounting.rbf: Same processor operations plus one RBFSampler.fit_transform per job. Prediction batches call transforms only; no extra learner fit.

failure_and_telemetry: Do not assert16 actual fits or fabricate zero. Successful strong leaf data_policy_runs reveals fit_on_rows calls; kernel success has one head fit by fixed source. Interrupted/failed leaves can have an unknown attempted count: retain available exact count/lower+upper/unknown, charge static job upper bound against cap before admission. No retries/additional jobs; total static bound stays16. Any actual counter>bound is technical failure.
